**Regulation to analyze:** FD&C Act section 524B (cyber devices), 21 U.S.C. 360n-2
**Why:** Cris Santos Company's primary industry here is connected medical devices, and section 524B is binding on every premarket submission for a cyber device (vulnerability monitoring and disclosure plan, secure development, patching, SBOM). Research note: for defense suppliers the better target is NIST SP 800-171 via DFARS 252.204-7012 and CMMC (see the Defense Industrial Base child); for other manufacturers with no binding rule, benchmark against NIST CSF 2.0 and NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3.
